lines.text: This is Maya. Twenty-three. Her first job offer just landed.
We'd love to offer you seventy-two thousand. Can I tell them you're on board?
Oh... um, sorry. I was kind of hoping for a bit more? But if not, that's totally fine.
The conversations that shape your career get one take. What if Maya could rehearse it first?
This is Scenar. A rehearsal room for hard conversations, where every AI counterpart hides something: a budget ceiling, a reason they won't say out loud.
So Maya practises. She anchors with real market data, and stays calm.
Every message is scored live on assertiveness, composure, clarity and boundaries, and the tension meter shows exactly how it landed.
Then the truth comes out. Dana could go to eighty-four thousand. Now Maya knows exactly what to ask for.
Pro runs on RevenueCat. Every paywall moment has its own placement, with a seven-day free trial.
Sandbox for testing, live Stripe payments for real. And the server verifies every purchase with RevenueCat before the sealed coaching unlocks.
Say it out loud. Build your own scenario. Track your progress, on any device.
Based on market data for this role, I'd be comfortable at eighty-five.
You know what? I think we can make eighty-three work.
